message: Cancel a task in one tap: ✕ on each task, «تلغيها؟» then «رجّعها» for 6 seconds; ask the giver to cancel («اطلب إلغاءها»); Found tasks in full before you decide; one «يحتاجك» with filters and one number; asks you can't give go to your manager; «لما تخلصها» on the task page; Meet reads meetings you attended; no stray spinner on iPhone; faster QA
